enderportals.book.page1:
§5The Paradise of Cubes§0

Every broken block, wherever it falls, must rest somewhere.

Beneath our worlds lies the Ender world: an endless cavern where undone matter sleeps, caught in a grey translucent mass.
enderportals.book.page2:
§5The Ore§0

An ancient ore surfaces in the End's stone. Its §bcrystals§0 hum with the rhythm of the vortex.

An iron pickaxe is enough to harvest them. Fortune yields more.
enderportals.book.page3:
§5The Dormant Door§0

Craft (bench):
§5O O O§0
§5O §bC §6★§0
§5O O O§0

§5O§0 = Crying Obsidian
§bC§0 = Ender Crystal
§6★§0 = Nether Star

Place it anywhere. It sleeps.
enderportals.book.page4:
§5The Ritual§0

Only a colossal impact can awaken it.

Take a §cMace§0, climb at least §c20 blocks§0, jump — and strike the door mid-air.

The impact will absorb your fall. Lightning will do the rest.
enderportals.book.page5:
§5The Key§0

Craft (vertical):
§bCrystal§0
§3Ender Pearl§0
§6Gold Ingot§0

Right-click the awakened door: the key binds.
Right-click the ground: the door materialises.
On the door: open, then dematerialise.
enderportals.book.page6:
§5The Ender Pickaxe§0

Craft: 3 crystals in a row, 2 sticks.

It alone can carve §7Ender Blocks§0, shattering them like glass.

4 crystals = 1 Ender Block
4 Blocks = 4 Ender Bricks.
enderportals.book.page7:
§5Your pocket base§0

Behind the door: your room, carved in the endless cavern. Beds and anchors work there.

One door per person — and the vortex refuses to awaken a door within the door.

Safe travels.
enderportals.tooltip.ender_bag: In the offhand, right-click: stores your top inventory row into your base (costs XP)

enderportals.book.page8:
§5The Item Transmitter§0

A machine of blinking lights from another age. Craft: 8 iron blocks around an ender chest, a redstone block on top.

Place it in your Ender base and attach any storage — chest, barrel, backpack — block to block, the network grows.
enderportals.book.page9:
§5The Ender Bag§0

Craft: a bundle and an ender chest.

In your §boffhand§0, right-click: the top row of your inventory flies into your base's storage network, wherever you are.

Each stored slot costs a little §aXP§0. Network full or too little XP: nothing leaves.
enderportals.book.page10:
§5The Great Network§0

The Transmitter speaks the common tongue of storage: barrels, backpacks — Sophisticated, Tom's — all answer, and filters sort on their own.

Stick it to a Tom's Inventory Connector: the Bag pours into the whole network, counted right.
